senses.gloss: m. (v. רָבַב Pi.) a thick, viscid mass, fat; grease, pitch &c.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 49a:2">Sot. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>אילמלא … מוכרי ר׳</he> but for David’s prayer, all Israelites would be sellers of grease.
<cite ref="Zevachim 98b:4">Zeb. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ על בגדו וכ׳</he> grease on a garment is an unlawful interposition (at its immersion), but if he is a seller of grease &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 20b:2">Sabb. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>של ר׳</he> (<cite ref="M00276"><he>מדורה</he></cite>) a fire made with fatty substances.
<cite ref="Shabbat 78b:3">Ib. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ כדי לסוך וכ׳</he> fat, as much as is required to smear under a small cake.
Ib. 114ᵃ כל ת״ח שנמצא ר׳ וכ׳ a scholar on whose garment there is a greasy stain &c.; Rabina said, רבד איתמר the word rabad was used (by R. Joḥanan), v. רָבָד.
